tool_args.rationale: The long-horizon probe establishes a transition from positive response at H=7.17 to negative response at H=14.76 and H=20.5. Fit the specified dual-exponential law numerically across all eight observations and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired observations span both short and long horizons, including the reversal, and constrain the stated four-parameter mechanism; another probe is not needed before confirmation.

The observations and verified mechanism note support a fast positive response followed by slow endogenous reversal; the Ricker map has no horizon dependence, and the harmonic alternative is not needed to explain the measured trajectory.
